title: A unique solution for bioelectronics: collagen and cacao butter
summary_en: Biomedical engineers at WashU McKelvey Engineering developed an additive manufacturing method using a 3D printer that builds bioelectronic materials from collagen and a polymer that can carry electrical signals, work that could ultimately improve the function of medical implants.
title_cn: A unique solution for bioelectronics: collagen and cacao butter

title: Cancer survivors less likely to be physically active, study finds
summary_en: Adults with a history of cancer are less likely to be physically active than those without a cancer history, finds a new study from Washington University in St. Louis.
title_cn: Cancer survivors less likely to be physically active, study finds

title: Blood proteins reveal effects of Alzheimer’s drug
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers found that dozens of blood proteins shifted during treatment with the anti-amyloid medication lecanemab, which could enable future blood tests monitoring a person’s response to the drug.
title_cn: Blood proteins reveal effects of Alzheimer’s drug
